data.name: Zakat
data.long_meaning: A voluntary payment in the form of money or goods to charitable causes, based on accumulated wealth, and prescribed by Islam as a religious duty
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of humility, gratitude, and faith, representing the purification of one's wealth and the upliftment of the community
